name: works-on-my-codex
description: Keep a thin, project-specific Codex harness current.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a thin, project-specific Codex harness current.
interface.longDescription: WOMC creates and refreshes a thin project harness when contextual reading routes, non-native skills, workspaces, or validation commands change. On an explicit WOMC update request, it refreshes the Git marketplace and installed plugin before updating the current project harness. It avoids reacting to ordinary document edits or duplicating natively discovered skill descriptions. Its trusted session hook performs only a read-only harness check and never changes personal Codex UI settings.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Works on My Codex harness in this project.
